item.title: Steelers announce new defensive quality control coach
item.description: The Steelers made a number of staff hires official Wednesday, including new offensive coordinator Brian Angelichio and new special teams coordinator Danny Crossman. item.title: Steelers expected to hire TCU assistant LBs coach

item.description: The Steelers are expected to hire Derius Swinton II as a senior special teams assistant, Jonathan Jones of CBS Sports reported Thursday.
